text_blocks.snippet: People over 65 should receive a second dose of the 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine six months after their first dose, according to the CDC. This recommendation is also extended to those who are moderately or severely immunocompromised. It is also important for this age group to stay up to date with COVID-19 vaccines due to decreasing vaccine protection over time, according to the CDC.
